The '''Timbra Ott system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Timbra Ott]].
